name: Scandit SDK
description: AI agent skills for integrating the Scandit Data Capture SDK — product selection, documentation, and implementation guides for barcode scanning, ID capture, and smart label capture.
longDescription:
Ships **86 skills**.

- **Skills** (86): `barcode-capture-android` (Scandit Barcode Capture (`BarcodeCapture`) in native Android (Kotlin/Java) projects — the low-level, full-control single-barcode scanning mode (BarcodeCapture +…), `barcode-capture-capacitor` (Capacitor — Scandit Barcode Capture (`BarcodeCapture`) in Capacitor (Ionic) hybrid apps via the Scandit Capacitor plugins (`ScanditCaptureCorePlugin`), the…), `barcode-capture-cordova` (Cordova — Scandit Barcode Capture (`BarcodeCapture`) in Apache Cordova hybrid apps via the `scandit-cordova-datacapture-*` plugins (global `window.Scandit`), the…), `barcode-capture-flutter` (Scandit Barcode Capture (`BarcodeCapture`) in Flutter (Dart) projects — the low-level, full-control single-barcode scanning mode (BarcodeCapture + DataCaptureView…), `barcode-capture-ios` (Scandit Barcode Capture (`BarcodeCapture`) in native iOS (Swift) projects — the low-level, full-control single-barcode scanning mode (BarcodeCapture +…), `barcode-capture-kmp` (Scandit Barcode Capture (`BarcodeCapture`) in Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and Compose Multiplatform projects using Scandit's KMP SDK (`com.kmp.datacapture.*` imports)…), `barcode-capture-net-android` (Scandit BarcodeCapture in .NET for Android projects (`net*-android` target framework, `Scandit.DataCapture.Barcode` NuGet, non-MAUI — for MAUI apps use…), `barcode-capture-net-ios` (Scandit BarcodeCapture in .NET for iOS projects (`net*-ios` target framework, `Scandit.DataCapture.Barcode` NuGet, non-MAUI — for MAUI apps use…), and 78 more

Installs with `claude plugin install scandit-sdk@claude-plugins-official` from `Scandit/skills`.
